reviews.title: Great value, pretty good quality
reviews.comment:
The sound is nearly indistinguishable from my AirPods Pro 2, which have great sound. These are missing some clarity, but if you can get these on sale they’re a great value. Also, they are very comfortable. Most comfortable headset/headphones I’ve ever used. The mesh over the drivers touches my ears, but it’s soft and I stopped noticing very quickly. I don’t use the mic so I can’t speak on that. The cable is nice. Thin and flexible.
So these aren’t the best of the best, but terrific value on sale. I recommend these if you want the most bang for your buck.
reviews.author: josh

reviews.title: Excellent Value For The Price - Great Backup Set
reviews.comment: I bought these on sale as a backup headset for my Sennheiser PC38X headphones. Well, the cable on my Sennheiser's stopped working, so while waiting on a new cable, I popped the Logitech's on. As a backup they work great. Sound is clear and you can hear what direction shots and enemies are coming from. Only issues I have is that they are a little tinny and bass lacking when compared to the Sennheiser's. The mic is very average too. Definitely wouldn't use these for listening to music or movies. If you can pick these up when they go on sale, you can't beat the value, making them an excellent backup option.
reviews.author: Obviousman

reviews.title: Best Headphones I've Ever Purchased
reviews.comment: The over-the-ear feature is exactly what I was looking. The earpiece material is made of cloth, unlike faux leather which eventually peels off. That's a plus for me. I don't really use the microphone, except for one occasion, and there were no issues. The sound quality is very good for gaming, music, even a TV/Cable sound system. The volume is fine enough, as I usually put the headphones on max volume and then do additional adjustments through the device it's connected to. It's bendable and twistable, lightweight and adjustable for any size/shaped head, and I even accidentally sat on them once, with no damage at all. They were so comfortable that I even bought one for my wife.
reviews.author: Bob M.

reviews.title: Headphones
reviews.comment: I bought these for my husband who is a gamer,  and he really enjoys them.  They’re affordable, and most sizes fit all. They work with most PC gaming units. They’re long lasting. They are soft and comfortable to use.  They have  decent cord length and great noise cancellation capabilities.  The volume is good as well.  They don’t store easily though. I think they are long lasting. My husband had this same pair before I bought this one for him and he said they lasted longer than 3 year.
reviews.author: Alex
